user_story: As a user, I want to register with the maximum allowed name length so that long names are handled correctly.

positive.title: Register with maximum allowed name length
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed characters.
Fill in other required fields with valid data.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered, and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to register with a name exceeding maximum length
steps: Enter a name longer than the maximum allowed characters.
Fill in other required fields with valid data.
negative.expected_result: Registration fails, and an error message indicates the name exceeds maximum length.

edge.title: Register with an empty name
steps: Fill in other required fields with valid data.
edge.expected_result: Registration fails, and an error message indicates that the name field is required.
